Q22: Some say that they just report 'publication bias corrected models' so they don't necessarily report a measure of publication bias per se

*Perhaps you could clarify that graphic-only assessments (without any tests) are also valid?
* What should be done when authors justify that it is not possible to assess publication bias (because of a too small number of studies)?
Publication bias is the keyword to be used. However, sometimes the authors tend to provide the results in the supplementary info.
Should we assess the quality of publication bias analysis? The fail-safe N number is not as powerful as Bayesian workflows that directly account for publication bias (ROBMA).
